verdict.rationale: Jira is an issue and project tracker. Reviewing code diffs and commenting on specific lines is a code-hosting or code-review capability, and nothing in the evidence shows Jira itself ships diff review, line comments or an agent iteration loop. Development-status visibility and Bitbucket integration are adjacent features that do not make this axis apply to Jira.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can review AI agent code changes and comment on specific lines from a mobile app, then have the agent iterate
